Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-04.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: Didn't I tell you? Unless you use every resource you have, you'll never defeat him. Now, go for it!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-06.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: This is the stone you've been looking for. Don't look so surprised! That was just a temporary partnership with Agnes of Goddard. It's not like you two were soulmates! Someday, you're really going to need this! So, take it!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-01.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: He's very tough! Gather your strength and attack him. You can do it!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-03.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: You let him get away! Listen to me and think before you act!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-05.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: Mind your own business! Get lost!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-07.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: Hmm, so I end up owing you a favor after all! OK, take this stone...
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-02.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: He's pretty tough. Get out of the way!
when: cond 17; st != null; st2 != null; !st == st2; !tab == 1

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-08.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: Is this going to be too hard? Don't worry, I'll deal with him. In the meantime, use this Stone of Commune to communicate with the Tablet of Vision. Hurry up!

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-010.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: You don't get it, do you? I lead a religious organization called Dawn Witness. Did you really think our meeting was a coincidence? Take this stone with you. You'll need it to carve your fate. I must be going. I wish you a bright future.

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-011.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: Looking for this? It's the Stone of Commune. You know, you helped me without my even asking you to! Please accept this stone as a gift.

Q00085_SagaOfTheCardinal/4-09.htm.text: Dawn Witness Franz: This Stone of Commune is used to communicate with the Tablet of Vision. Now, start communicating!
